title: Quake II demo 3.14 — id Software, 1998
author: id Software
notes: id Software's Quake II demo of March 1998 (q2-314-demo-x86.exe, from id's own FTP), freely distributed by electronic means with its licence (license.txt, beside it here). The executable as id built it, with its own DLLs: quake2.exe loads ref_soft.dll, its software renderer, and gamex86.dll, the game, from its directory; MIRAGE-WIN32 maps them as Windows does (relocated, their imports bound, DllMain run) and answers their Win32 calls in JavaScript. It draws full screen through DirectDraw (an 8-bit display mode and its palette), plays its sound through DirectSound, and starts Winsock on a network with nobody else on it; single play goes through its own loopback.
